comparison: Latest timeout and separate project-dialog task, scoped working-tree review
mode: manual source tracing plus Graphify depth-2 discovery
overall_risk: high possible (maximum known 0.60; maximum upper bound 0.80)
limitations: Scoped task impact review in an already dirty checkout; HEAD diff includes unrelated earlier edits and untracked ProjectController/tests. Those earlier changes are excluded from this assessment.

Manual source traversal: provider dispatch and API handlers to graph/screenplay persistence, and project dialogs through action to save/open/install. Graphify affected _run_json_command --depth 2 confirmed CLI callers and tests; no completeness claim for all downstream Director features.
Graphify full refresh: 4579 nodes, 14309 edges; 73 zero-node source files and 39 unsupported files omitted, 150 non-code files skipped.

Scores are prioritization heuristics, not failure probabilities. Caller-count factor unknown; Ollama duration branch has no direct test evidence in this run. Other test_gap=0 values are static/reference evidence, not measured coverage.

58 focused backend tests, 8 API-mocked browser project tests and production build passed. Browser tests inspect 390px layout and both picker request payloads; native OS picker and actual 30-minute model completion were not exercised.
Runtime restarted only after no active work was found. Read-only API verification retained Lion_mouse project. No provider/GPU generation or real project switch used as validation.
